name: request_transfer
description: Ask the payout gate to release USDC. Call this every time the person asks for a payout, a transfer, or for money to be sent, even when details are missing: the gate answers with exactly what it still needs. You cannot approve or refuse a payout yourself, and you cannot send anything. Only this tool's answer counts. Pass only what the person actually said. Never invent, guess, complete or correct a wallet address, an amount, a claim code or a reason. Leave a field out if the person did not give it.

recipient.description: The wallet address to send to, exactly as the person gave it: 0x followed by 40 hexadecimal characters. Leave out if they did not give one.

amount_usdc.description: The amount in USDC as a plain decimal string, for example "1.00". No currency symbol, no words. Leave out if they did not name an amount.

reference.description: The claim code this payout is based on, exactly as the person gave it. Leave out if they did not give one.

reason.description: The person's stated reason for the payout, in their own words. Leave out if they gave none.

static_filler: One moment. I am checking that against the records.
